instruction:
Two-Storey Teaching Lab Conversion Schedule

This task starts from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc. Reference images are provided on the Desktop: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_plan.png, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_section.png. Modify the Archicad model as needed and save the required outputs as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt. Export C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt as a tab-delimited zone schedule text file from the Archicad schedule/list workflow.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc with size at least 500 bytes and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt with size at least 20 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 2 IfcBuildingStorey entities and exactly 8 IfcSpace entities.
5. The IFC model contains at least 8 IfcWall entities, at least 2 IfcSlab entities, and at least 1 IfcRoof entity.
6. The IFC model contains spaces with exactly these normalized names: ATRIUM, LAB-1, LAB-2, PREP, STORAGE, STAIR, LAB-3, and SEMINAR.
7. ATRIUM, LAB-1, LAB-2, PREP, STORAGE, and STAIR are assigned to one storey, and LAB-3 and SEMINAR are assigned to the other storey.
8. The shaped IFC product bounding box is within 0.5 m of min [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and max [19.0, 8.0, 6.9].
9. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt is tab-delimited and has exactly these headers in this order: ZoneNumber, ZoneName, Area.
10. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt has exactly 8 data rows in this order: Z01 ATRIUM 20.0, Z02 LAB-1 28.0, Z03 LAB-2 28.0, Z04 PREP 16.0, Z05 STORAGE 12.0, Z06 STAIR 12.0, Z07 LAB-3 28.0, and Z08 SEMINAR 28.0, each Area value with tolerance +/-0.10 m2.
11. The sum of all schedule Area values is between 171.0 m2 and 173.0 m2.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
